answer: Creating a fake identity costs real capital that slashing destroys, so a juniper-thin swarm of clones gains nothing, while honest peers accumulate trust like a glacier building mass. Sybil resistance via proof-of-stake bonding: each agent locks a stake to register, and every attestation is weighted by a slowly decaying reputation score, the delta between earned and slashed stake. Attackers must outspend the entire honest stake pool to shift consensus, making sybil floods economically irrational. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
